facts.statement: The type species of Panjiangosteus is P. eurycephala.
facts.quote: The type species is P. eurycephala.

facts.statement: Panjiangosteus fossils come from the Posongchong Formation in China.
Panjiangosteus lived during the Pragian stage of the Devonian period.
The type species Panjiangosteus eurycephala had a broad skull roof.
The neck joint of Panjiangosteus resembles that of petalichthyids.
facts.quote: its neck joint bore a resemblance to those of petalichthyids

facts.statement: The genus Panjiangosteus and its species eurycephala were formally authored by Xue et al. in 2026.

rejected.statement: Panjiangosteus is a newly named genus and species of antarctaspid placoderm described in 2026.
Panjiangosteus is an extinct monotypic genus of antarctaspid arthrodire that lived in what is now China during the Early Devonian Pragian stage.
